description: Favourable thermal trap vs three matched nulls, every other parameter held equal. Attributes which transport term the localized enrichment depends on.
attribution: enrichment collapses under each of: gradient_off, flow_off, open_pore
note: The accumulation Péclet (hence the enrichment) depends on all three transport terms — the thermal gradient (ΔT), the convective flow, and the pore confinement (porosity): each off-null collapses enrichment ~10⁸× → ~1. Consistent with og-spatial-concentration's Péclet-gated framing; gate/verdict unchanged. (Off-nulls use epsilon 1e-9, not 0.0 — a bare 0.0 is backfilled to the default by the pbg is_empty rule and silently reproduces the favourable arm.)
